title: Reference approach: Custom Training Loop
answer: Implement custom training loop in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: optimizer.zero_grad, loss.backward, optimizer.step, model.eval. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 060. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
torch.manual_seed(0); model=nn.Linear(1,1); opt=torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1); x=torch.tensor([[1.],[2.]]); y=2*x
for _ in range(10): opt.zero_grad(); loss=((model(x)-y)**2).mean(); loss.backward(); opt.step()
model.eval()
with torch.inference_mode(): print(model(torch.tensor([[3.]])).shape)
